mods.name: Horse Breeding Helper
mods.description: A Minecraft Fabric mod that helps you identify the best horses for breeding by displaying their scores and diamond values when mounting them, with RPG-style rarity classification.

releases.notes:
# Horse Breeding Helper v1.0.1 - Hotfix Release

## 🔧 Hotfix Changes

### **New Features**
- ✅ **Horse Score Display on Mount** - Shows detailed score and diamond value when mounting any horse
- ✅ **Diamond Pricing System** - Exponential pricing curve with values from 0.00 to 100.00 💎
- ✅ **Conditional Debug Mode** - Detailed breakdown only shows when F6 highlighting is enabled

### **Improvements**
- ✅ **Accurate Scoring System** - Fixed scoring calculations using official Minecraft horse stat ranges
- ✅ **Better Pricing Curve** - Slower growth at lower scores, explosive growth at high scores
- ✅ **Clean User Experience** - Essential info always available, debug info only when needed

### **Display Format**
```
Horse Score: 76.3 (Rare) | Value: 5.41 💎
```

### **Technical Details**
- Uses official Minecraft horse stat ranges (Speed: 0.1125-0.3375, Jump: 0.4-1.0, Health: 15-30)
- Exponential pricing formula: `value = 100 × ((score - 50) / 50)^3.5`
- RPG-style tier system: Legendary, Rare, Uncommon, Common, Poor

### **Requirements**
- Minecraft 1.21.8
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

---

**Download the JAR file and place it in your mods folder!** 🐎✨

releases.notes:
🎉 Horse Breeding Helper v1.0.0 - Initial Release
🆕 What's New
🎨 RPG-Style Horse Classification

Horses are now automatically rated with 5-tier rarity system
Color-coded boxes: Legendary (Magenta), Rare (Light Blue), Uncommon (Yellow), Common (Green), Poor (Red)
Instant visual identification of breeding quality
🏆 Top Horse Highlighting

Special white pulsing boxes around the 2 best horses in your area
15% larger boxes with gentle animation effects
Never miss the perfect breeding pair again
🎯 Smart Detection System

100-block radius automatic scanning
Real-time score calculation based on speed, jump height, and health
F6 toggle with informative chat feedback
🧮 Advanced Scoring Algorithm

Comprehensive evaluation of all three key horse attributes
Converts raw stats to real-world units (blocks/second, jump height, hearts)
Balanced 0-100 point scoring system for fair comparison

🔧 Technical Features
Client-side only - works on any server
Zero performance impact on multiplayer
Multi-layered rendering with fallback compatibility
Efficient caching and real-time updates

🎮 Usage
Press F6 to toggle highlighting
Colored boxes appear around horses within 100 blocks
White pulsing boxes mark the top 2 horses
Use higher-tier horses for optimal breeding results

📦 Requirements
Minecraft 1.21.8
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
